name: Manfred (@_EBFE)
biography: Manfred (@_EBFE) has been reverse engineering and exploiting MMORPGs for 20 years. During that time, he ran a successful business based solely on exploiting online games in order to supply virtual goods to retailers. He has reverse engineered communication protocols for over 22 well known and popular MMORPGs and in certain cases circumvented anti tampering and software/hardware fingerprinting countermeasures. Manfred is currently a security researcher and analyst at Independent Security Evaluators (@ISEsecurity). @_EBFE
